paragraphs: From Dungarvan Test Centre on Shandon, move off and take the small roundabout slight left onto the unnamed link road.
At the next roundabout on the N25, take the slight left exit to stay on the N25.
At the mini-roundabout, take the slight left exit.
At Strandside Roundabout, take the slight left exit.
At Coolagh Road Roundabout, take the slight left exit.
Bear slight left onto the unnamed road and follow it for about half a kilometre.
Continue right to join a short section of the N25, then turn right into Tournore Park.
In Tournore Park, pull in and complete a safe turnabout, then make your way back out of the estate.
At the end of Tournore Park, turn left onto the L3168.
Take the next left onto the unnamed road.
At the small roundabout, take the slight left exit onto Coolagh Road.
Turn right onto Sexton Street and continue straight as it becomes Causeway.
At the roundabout on Bridge Street, take the left exit.
Continue straight as the road becomes Saint Mary Street.
Turn right onto Mitchel Street, then left onto Rices Street.
Pull in on Rices Street for a manoeuvre if asked.
Move off and take the next right onto Collins Road.
Turn left back onto Mitchel Street and continue straight as it becomes Springmount.
At The Spring Roundabout, take the slight left exit.
Follow the unnamed road, then turn right onto the L3102.
In The Paddocks, complete a turnabout and exit back onto the L3102.
Turn left onto the R672.
At the roundabout, go straight ahead.
At the next roundabout on the N25, go straight ahead.
At the following roundabout, take the left exit back onto Shandon toward the test centre.
For a final loop, move off from Shandon and turn right onto Richard A. Walsh Street.
Turn right again onto John Treacy Street.
Take the slight left exit at the next roundabout.
At Kilrush Roundabout, take the slight left exit.
At the next roundabout, take the left exit onto the L3102.
Turn left onto the unnamed road to finish back toward Dungarvan Test Centre.
